title: Dactyl #51-#57 lightweight pure-Rust datastore
intent: Implement the missing Dactyl storage primitives in Rust, using Turso only as conceptual inspiration and never as a dependency, while preserving a trait-based backend-neutral local/Neon API and no SQLite C dependencies.
stop_conditions: Do not add SQLite C bindings, rusqlite, subprocess execution, Turso runtime dependencies, retries, or schema/migration policy.
